question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution protects monuments or a place of artistic or historical interest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 49**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 49:-**

 
 
• It protects monuments or a place of artistic or historical interest.
 
• This article directs the state to protect every monument or place or object of artistic or historical interest declared by or under
